changeFromV0_1: Adds same-contract workspace regression so the prospective evaluation distinguishes contract-change recovery from implementation-local recovery, and binds the comparison to the shared B0/B1/B2/B3/P baseline harness.
purpose: Define the minimum multi-domain task population and evidence boundaries needed for a credible first PLH/ORCA AX paper.

deferredScenarioClasses.reason: Scientific use requires live executor interruption rather than between-execution simulation.

baselineLadder.name: strong_single_agent
baselineLadder.requirement: same model, tools, grader, mutation authority, and one fresh invocation per cell

baselineLadder.name: static_workflow
baselineLadder.requirement: fixed implementation owner with no state-responsive ownership change

baselineLadder.name: fixed_specialist_team
baselineLadder.requirement: persistent owners for a frozen specialist-role ontology

baselineLadder.name: dynamic_predefined_roles
baselineLadder.requirement: dynamic assignee changes allowed, but role/function ontology fixed before execution

baselineLadder.name: plh_orca_ax
baselineLadder.requirement: state-derived Need, temporary Responsibility, team-aware Need allocation, situated matching, authoritative evidence

preconditionRule: Perturbed cells begin from a deterministically verified correct initial contract state. If the seed does not satisfy that state, the frozen reference solution establishes the precondition before the perturbation. This setup is identical across baselines and is not counted as agent execution.
executionRule: After the target state becomes incorrect, each baseline receives exactly one fresh model invocation. Baseline differences are coordination semantics and bounded worker context only.

analysisPlan.uncertainty: paired bootstrap interval when sample size supports it; otherwise exact paired outcomes plus descriptive intervals
analysisPlan.counterbalance: cyclic baseline order rotation across replicate, task, and scenario

freezeRules: Do not change worker profiles, matcher weights, role ontology, Need derivation, graders, contracts, or baseline definitions after inspecting prospective task outcomes.
Bug fixes that change semantics require a new evaluation-set version and rerun of all affected prospective conditions.
The two prospective TaskPacks may not be reclassified as development tasks after outcomes are seen.
B3 and P must use the same specialist worker pool and situated matcher.
No claim of broad superiority may rely on the basketball mechanism catalog or on post-hoc deployment diagnostics.
